{{Quote|Carnivore Battalion, Walker 773! Let's go!|[[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], to the troops of Carnivore Battalion|<ref name="Cargo" />}}
Walker '''773''' was a designation of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]] it was manned by [[Carnivore Battalion/Legends|Carnivore Battalion]], who along with two other brigades and two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], used the AT-TEs to board a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in their hunt the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], wanted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for numerous crimes. At the end of the operation the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] exploded, along with the walker, which was still attached to its hull.<ref name="Cargo" />
